## Catálogo Interactivo

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| column: screen

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(reactable)
library(reactablefmtr)
library(htmltools)
library(fontawesome)

# Load the data
movies_data <- readr::read_csv("data/final_results/all_movies.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Poster = if_else(is.na(Poster) | Poster == "N/A", "https://i.imgur.com/Ngnm5v6.png", Poster)
  )

# Define the UI with download button and table
htmltools::browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$button(
      tagList(fontawesome::fa("download"), "Download Selected as CSV"),
      onclick = "Reactable.downloadDataCSV('movie-table', 'selected_movies.csv', { selected: true })"
    ),
    reactable(
      movies_data,
      columns = list(
        Poster = colDef(
          name = 'Poster',
          cell = embed_img(height = 200, width = 150)
        ),
        Title = colDef(name = 'Pelicula'),
        Released = colDef(name = 'Lanzamiento'),
        Rated = colDef(name = 'Clasificación'),
        Director = colDef(name = 'Director'),
        Writer = colDef(name = 'Escritor'),
        Country = colDef(name = 'País'),
        Plot = colDef(name = 'Trama'),
        Genre = colDef(name = "Generos"),
        # Hide columns not needed for display but useful for export
        imdbID = colDef(show = FALSE),
        Year = colDef(show = FALSE),
        Ratings = colDef(show = FALSE),
        Metascore = colDef(show = FALSE),
        imdbRating = colDef(show = FALSE),
        imdbVotes = colDef(show = FALSE),
        Type = colDef(show = FALSE),
        DVD = colDef(show = FALSE),
        BoxOffice = colDef(show = FALSE),
        Production = colDef(show = FALSE),
        Website = colDef(show = FALSE),
        Response = colDef(show = FALSE),
        OriginalTitle = colDef(show = FALSE),
        totalSeasons = colDef(show = FALSE),
        SourcePDF = colDef(show = FALSE)
      ),
      selection = "multiple",
      onClick = "select",
      searchable = TRUE,
      pagination = TRUE,
      defaultColDef = colDef(align = 'center'),
      elementId = "movie-table"
    )
  )
)
```
